d: One of the greatest of all time, Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, bringing an extraordinary 23-year journey with Portugal to an unexpected end. But is this really the farewell he had imagined? From his emotional FIFA World Cup exit and the disappointment of missing out on the one trophy that has eluded him, to the questions surrounding his relationship with Portugal's manager, there is much more to this decision than meets the eye. Rupha Ramani looks back at Ronaldo's Portugal career, his incredible records, Euro 2016 triumph and the bittersweet…
